Independent software studio in Hong Kong. I design and ship software that stays fast, legible, and easy to change.

# Who I Am

I am the person behind LX Software. I work with founders and small teams on products that have to be clear on day one and still make sense a year later.

This biography is a placeholder. The portrait is ASCII art, not a photograph. Both will be replaced with the real introduction.

# What I Do

Four kinds of work. The descriptions are placeholders until the real service list is written.

Product engineering: Web applications, from the first sketch to a deploy that can be repeated.

Interface design: Screens that stay readable, keyboard friendly, and quiet under the content.

Cloud delivery: Static sites and services on AWS, with the infrastructure described in code.

Care and repair: Taking over an existing codebase, naming what is fragile, and making the next change safer.

Skills: TypeScript, React, Python, AWS, CDK, SQL

# FAQ

What does LX Software do?
LX Software is an independent software studio in Hong Kong. I design and build web software, then look after it.

Where are you based?
Hong Kong.

How do I get in touch?
Use the Contact Me section: telephone, email, WhatsApp, or WeChat, whichever is configured. Email reaches hello@lx-software.com.

Does this site collect email addresses?
No. There is no newsletter signup and no account. If you write, call, or message, that conversation is used only to reply.

# Privacy Policy

Draft

This is a placeholder privacy policy, not legal advice. Replace it before relying on it.

Who

This site is published by LX Software, an independent studio in Hong Kong. The contact mailbox is hello@lx-software.com.

What this site collects

The site does not run accounts, comments, or a newsletter. It does not ask you to create a profile.

The host keeps ordinary server logs (IP address, user agent, requested URL, and time) to operate and secure the site. Those logs are not used for advertising.

When you get in touch

If you email, call, or message through the contact links, I use that conversation to reply. I do not sell it and I do not add you to a mailing list.

Cookies and media

This site does not set advertising cookies. The harbour video is decoration. It has no audio and carries no extra tracking pixel of its own. It is served from this site, or from media.lx-software.com when that host is configured.
